verdicts.rationale: Both entries reference Pylyshyn's 'Seeing and Visualizing: It's Not What You Think'. One is the MIT Press book (2006); the other is the Choice Reviews Online catalog notice of that same book (2004, carrying the choice DOI). Same underlying work.
All four members are identical: Tichý, 'A counterexample to the Stalnaker-Lewis analysis of counterfactuals', Philosophical Studies 29(4):271-273, 1976, same DOI. Same work.

Warmbröd, 'Counterfactuals and substitution of equivalent antecedents', J. Philosophical Logic 10(2):267-289, 1981. Third member lacks the DOI but has identical title/author/year/journal/volume/pages. Same work.
